about: On the Varrock Museum's Natural History floor beside Orlando Smith, with 50 Slayer, Hunter and Mining, his quiz not yet taken on and no display done.
notes: For test-runner/examples/museum-quiz.json: the varbits are the 242 cache's vm_kudos (3637), vm_reward_50 (3640), vm_nathis_agreed (3671), the fourteen vm_nathis_*_display (3672-3685) and vm_nathis_reward_given (3688), set to 0 so the quiz can repeat on one account; ::reset puts them back. The levels keep Orlando's and the clerk's XP from opening level-up boxes. Orlando stands at 1759, 4955 (npc-spawns/varrock.json); the tile beside him is guessed walkable.
